verdict.rationale: Missions let you work with Droid to define features, milestones, and success criteria before any code is written. Droid also proposes changes and shows what will be modified before applying anything, and the CLI exposes approvals and tiered autonomy for manual confirmation. Together these cover reviewing and gating an agent's intended work before changes land. Missing for 10: an explicit documented plan/spec approval step (e.g. a dedicated plan mode with approve/reject), detail on how plans are edited before execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
